3: "Such as tashlumei kefel, etc." — (Hagahah: See in the Sma se'if katan 5, up to "and one can say, etc.," that they [Chazal] gave the din of kenas to a matter that is not shechiach or that has no chisaron kis in it, etc. And so too the Maharshal wrote in the Yam Shel Shlomo there siman 6, that in the language of the Shas we also find that something that is not shechiach is called kenas, and he brings a proof from the Shas that says "you are collecting kenas for boshes in Bavel?!" etc. See there.)
